name: careerly
description: Desktop app to tailor CVs with AI and track job applications.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @careerly/contracts && npm run build -w @careerly/api -w @careerly/web -w @careerly/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @careerly/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web,desktop -c gray,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @careerly/contracts" "npm run dev -w @careerly/api" "npm run dev -w @careerly/web" "npm run dev -w @careerly/desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @careerly/contracts" "npm run dev -w @careerly/api" "npm run dev -w @careerly/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @careerly/desktop
